title: Cosmic Lakeside Cabin
description: A red wooden cabin with a dock sits on the shore of a glowing lake under a swirling purple and green night sky filled with shooting stars, multiple moons, and a bright orange sun. In the foreground, a lone figure rows a small wooden boat across water that reflects the cosmic colors and contains floating luminous orbs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night featuring a bright red wooden cabin with chimney on a rocky shore with wooden dock, a lone rower in a small wooden boat on a calm lake, dramatic swirling purple and green aurora sky filled with numerous shooting stars, multiple moons of different sizes, and one bright orange sun, glowing purple orbs floating in the water, distant dark mountains, vibrant cinematic colors, dreamy atmosphere
